what.text: This page follows refugees from Russia living in Azerbaijan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 259 Russian refugees in Azerbaijan, 0.3% of all refugees from Russia.
France hosts the most Russian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Chechnya territory in Russia from 1994 to 1996 and from 1999 to 2007, and over Caucasus Emirate territory from 2007 to 2015.
The main year of displacement in the data, 2004, falls within the second Chechnya period.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 155 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 8367, at the end of 2004, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Azerbaijan.
These are year-end totals for Azerbaijan only, reported to UNHCR.
